verdict.rationale: Bun documents dedicated CLI commands for each operation. `bun add` writes to package.json with --dev/--optional/--peer/--exact/--catalog options. `bun remove` removes the package from every dependency group in package.json and updates bun.lock, including in workspaces. `bun update`/`bun up` upgrades direct and transitive deps, with an --interactive mode, and `bun dedupe` saves bun.lock, so an agent never needs to hand-edit either file. missing for 10: explicit statement that `bun add` updates bun.lock, documented upgrade beyond declared ranges (e.g. a latest flag), evidence of safe/atomic rewrite behavior, independent hands-on corroboration.
